description: Walks a Polymarket outcome's live order book to recommend how many clips to split a large position into, so each clip's own price impact stays at or under max_price_impact_pct_per_slice (default 1.0%). Also returns full_size_price_impact_pct - the baseline impact if filled in one shot right now, for comparison. Single-snapshot calculation - it has no idea whether the book refills between clips in real trading. Accepts either a raw token_id or a market_slug (+ outcome) to resolve it automatically - exact slug only, no fuzzy keyword search. Paid in USDC on Base.

market_slug.description: Exact Polymarket market slug, used to resolve token_id automatically.

max_price_impact_pct_per_slice.description: Target ceiling on each clip's own price impact, in percent. Defaults to 1.0.

outcome.description: "yes" (default) or "no" - which side to resolve when using market_slug.

position_size_shares.description: Total number of outcome shares to sell (or buy). Must be positive.

token_id.description: The outcome's CLOB token_id / asset_id, if already known.

name: prediction.order_split_guide
